about.heading: Engineering with purpose, designing with intention.
about.bio1: I'm a full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications and thoughtful user interfaces. I believe great software is built at the intersection of clean engineering and intentional design.
about.bio2: With a background spanning both engineering and design, I bring a holistic perspective to every project. I specialize in React ecosystems, Node.js backends, and creating interfaces that feel as good as they work. Currently open to exciting opportunities and collaborations.
about.philosophy: I write code the same way I design — with intention. Every line should serve a purpose, every component should earn its place. I value simplicity, clarity, and the kind of craftsmanship that users feel even when they can't quite explain it.
